header.title: Reporting cycles
header.subtitle: Each cycle moves from setup to active, locked and published. Locking freezes assignment edits; publishing stamps a hash and makes the cycle read-only for good.

empty.title: No reporting periods
empty.body: Create a period for this framework to open assignments and start collecting data.

error.title: Reporting cycles didn't load
error.body: We couldn't reach the server, so nothing is shown rather than an empty list. Try again.

card.archivedNote: Archived. Read-only, kept for restatements and audit.

next.setup: Start the period to open assignments.
next.active: Lock when data collection is complete.
next.locked: Publish to seal the period with a hash.
next.published: Archive once the report has been filed.

confirm.lock: Lock {{label}}? Assignment edits will be blocked.
confirm.publish: Publish {{label}}? This stamps a hash and makes the period read-only forever.
confirm.lockBody: Assignment edits will be blocked for everyone. Submitted values stay in review and approval.
confirm.publishBody: Publishing stamps a tamper-evident hash over every approved value and makes this period read-only permanently. It can't be undone; corrections need a restatement.
confirm.archiveBody: The period moves out of the active list. Its published data and hash stay available for audit.

drawer.title: New reporting period
drawer.subtitle: Dates are optional and can be set later, until the period is locked.
